about: The study room, as /en/camp is one camp: the 40 ft teal container of the compound (src/components/home/compound.json, unit "study") on a 300 mm stone plinth, a band of glazed sliding doors behind timber louvres along its north side onto a 2 m deck with a broad step, the courtyard in front and the lake behind. Furnished as a working room for startups and small businesses, to hold a discussion, run a training or work on a project together: eight seats round one long timber table in the middle, a screen and a whiteboard wall at one end, a bookshelf wall and a reading corner at the far end. The 2D (study-room-plan.tsx) and the 3D (scripts/site/render/study-room.html) both read this file. Plan in metres: x to the right as seen from the deck (east on the left, west on the right), y toward the front (the glazing, north), the container's centre at 0,0. Sizes past the container and the compound's openings are design choices, not yet sourced; furniture colour is the studio's Medium Oak.

container.about: A standard 40 ft box (not a high cube), outside 12.192 x 2.438 x 2.591 m, painted teal as in the footage (IMG_3196). Cargo doors at the west end stay shut.

room.about: Inside the lining (battens, insulation and 12 mm ply, painted off-white): 11.94 x 2.26 m; floor 160 mm over the container's base, oak planks as in the studio; clear height about 2.3 m.

glazing.about: As in the compound: one glazed opening along the north wall from 0.6 m inside each end, white-framed sliding panels about 1.5 m wide, 2.09 m high; louvres 60 mm thick at 450 mm centres stand 0.3-0.42 m out in front, under a timber head.

deck.about: Eucalyptus boards the full length of the container, 2 m out to the north, at the plinth's height; a broad 0.4 m step along it, stopping 2 m short of each end.

table.about: One long oak table down the middle of the room, between the screen wall and the reading corner, 3.6 x 0.75 m, four chairs along each side facing across it: eight seats. It takes most of the room's width: with the chairs pushed in about 0.27 m stays behind each, so seats are reached round the table's ends. x is the table's centre, seats each chair's x from it.

screen.about: The east end wall, the room's front for workshops and training: a 65-inch screen on a slatted oak panel, a low cabinet under it, a whiteboard wall 2.8 m wide on the back wall beside it, from the corner to the table's end, for sketching a plan or a project board, and a small lectern table for whoever is presenting.

shelves.about: The bookshelf wall: full-height open oak shelves across the west end wall, 0.32 m deep, five bays and six shelves, books and a few plants on them.

reading.about: The reading corner by the bookshelves: two upholstered armchairs angled toward the glazing, a round side table between them, a floor lamp and a woven rug. Each chair: x, y of its centre and its turn in radians.

plants.about: Large floor plants in pots (x, y, height): a low one in the screen corner by the glazing, two between the table and the reading corner, kept clear of the screen and the shelves. Small ones on the shelves are drawn in the 3D only.

lights.about: Pendants: three dome shades in a line over the long table, about 1.95 m above the floor; two over the reading corner.

fans.about: No air conditioning: the room is cooled by the glazed doors opened to the deck and the louvres' shade, with two wall fans high on the back wall, one over the table and one over the reading corner. x is each fan's centre.

electric.about: The study room's wiring in the studio's pattern (D-021): a surface unit board on the back wall, a double-pole main switch and type 2 surge protection, one RCBO 30 mA type A per circuit, cables in conduit in the linings. A double socket on the back wall behind each pair of seats, so each of the eight seats has its own; the screen wall and the reading corner on a circuit of their own; no air conditioning, two wall fans instead. The supply is a cable from the farm's site board; its size is the electrician's. Points in plan metres (x, y as the plan, z above the finished floor) at their centre; size in mm (w, h, d). design_A: lights and the fan from their watts at 230 V; the table at eight laptops of about 65 W each [A]; the screen and the corner at a 65-inch screen and a lamp [A]; rwf: the studio BOM's placeholder unit prices (AS-21), not quotes. existing: drawn by the room's own 3D already (the pendants, the wall fans).

network.about: Wi-Fi for twelve laptops and the screen: one ceiling access point, powered over its cable from the office's PoE switch, which the outdoor cable reaches through an entry box low on the back wall (the office's network, office.json). The screen casts over the Wi-Fi and has a data outlet as a fallback. Nothing is sourced or priced yet.
